readmeHtml:
AI-powered fashion visualization and virtual try-on toolkit for consent-based garment editing, outfit prototyping, and creative design workflows. https://undress.design/edit?utm_source=gist.github.com/chordswallowthrust/undress-design

✨ Undress Design

Undress Design is an AI-assisted fashion visualization project for experimenting with clothing concepts, outfit variations, garment replacement, and virtual styling.

The project is intended for designers, developers, creative teams, and researchers working with responsible image-generation workflows.

🚀 Features

  • 👗 Virtual garment visualization
  • 🎨 Outfit and style variations
  • 🧵 Fashion concept prototyping
  • ✂️ Clothing segmentation and masking
  • 🖼️ Design reference generation
  • ✅ Consent-based image editing workflows
  • ⚙️ API-ready integration architecture

🌐 Website

Learn more and try the platform:

🛡️ Responsible Use

Undress Design is designed exclusively for lawful, ethical, and consent-based applications.

Users must:

  • ✅ process only images they own or have explicit permission to use;
  • 🤝 obtain informed consent from every identifiable person depicted;
  • 🚫 avoid sexualized, deceptive, abusive, or non-consensual edits;
  • 🔞 avoid generating content involving minors;
  • 🔒 respect privacy, intellectual-property, and publicity rights;
  • 🏷️ clearly label AI-generated or AI-edited media where appropriate.

This project must not be used to remove clothing from photographs, generate intimate imagery, impersonate individuals, or create misleading representations of real people.

💡 Use Cases

  • 👚 Virtual try-on experiences
  • 🎭 Fashion moodboards
  • 🛍️ E-commerce product visualization
  • 🦸 Costume and character design
  • 🧥 Garment replacement prototypes
  • 📢 Creative advertising concepts
  • 🔬 Research into responsible generative AI

📌 Status

This repository contains project information, integration examples, and documentation related to the Undress Design platform.

⚠️ Disclaimer

AI-generated results may contain visual inaccuracies. Users are responsible for reviewing generated content and ensuring that its creation and distribution comply with applicable laws, platform policies, and consent requirements.

aiSummary.oneLiner: AI-powered fashion visualization toolkit for virtual try-ons, garment replacement, and consent-based styling workflows.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Undress Design is an AI-assisted fashion visualization platform designed to help creatives experiment with clothing concepts and virtual styling. It provides a comprehensive toolkit for outfit variations, garment replacement, and advanced clothing segmentation. The project explicitly focuses on responsible, consent-based image editing workflows, aiming to serve designers, developers, and creative teams in the fashion industry. It offers a robust API-ready architecture to integrate virtual try-on capabilities into existing e-commerce or prototyping pipelines. The platform strictly enforces ethical usage policies, prohibiting the generation of non-consensual or inappropriate imagery while providing powerful tools for legitimate fashion visualization.
keyFeatures: Virtual Garment Visualization: Seamlessly replace and visualize new garments on existing subject photos.
Advanced Segmentation: Provides precise clothing segmentation and masking tools to isolate specific pieces of an outfit.
Outfit Prototyping: Rapidly generate and test different style variations and fashion concepts using generative AI.
API-Ready Architecture: Designed for easy integration into custom applications, e-commerce platforms, or enterprise workflows.
Consent-Based Workflows: Built with strong ethical guardrails prioritizing responsible use and clear labeling of AI-edited media.

useCases.title: Virtual E-commerce Try-On
useCases.description: Integrate the API into a retail website to allow customers to accurately visualize how different garments will look on models.

useCases.title: Fashion Moodboarding
useCases.description: Enable fashion designers to rapidly prototype new clothing concepts and fabric replacements on existing reference photos.

useCases.title: Costume Design Prototyping
useCases.description: Allow character designers and costumers to test out varying historical or fantastical outfits on actors without physical fittings.

useCases.title: Creative Advertising Campaigns
useCases.description: Generate multiple high-quality styling variations of a single photoshoot for targeted digital marketing campaigns.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Fashion designers, e-commerce developers, and creative agencies working with responsible image-generation workflows. It is intended for professionals requiring precise, ethical tools for garment visualization and virtual styling.
